info.title: CqrsLens 0.8.0 - see your MediatR codebase.
info.description: See your MediatR codebase: CqrsLens statically scans a .NET solution (no build required) and generates an ARCHITECTURE.md report with Mermaid diagrams of your project graph, CQRS map, layers, and DbContexts.

options.name: --output
options.description: Report path. Default: ARCHITECTURE.md (.html or .json) in the current directory.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Config file. Default: <path>/.cqrslens.json when present.
Settings: analysis, render, watermark, markers, handlerMarkers, include/exclude globs, layers, rules.

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format: md (default), html, json, or agent. A .html, .json, or .agent.md -o path implies that format.

options.name: --slice
options.description:
Filter and trace vertical slices matching FILTER (endpoint, request, handler, entity, or event).
Streams directly to stdout when -o is omitted.

options.name: --mcp
options.description: Start the built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server over JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Print per-stage timing and allocation totals to stderr.

options.name: --render
options.description: HTML diagram rendering: mermaid (default) or svg (zero-JS inline SVG).

options.name: --analysis
options.description: Analysis backend: text (default) or roslyn (opt-in).

options.name: --generated-at
options.description:
Fixed ISO-8601 timestamp for reproducible reports (tests/CI);
timing is reported as 0 ms in this mode.

options.name: --markers
options.description:
Comma-separated custom marker interface names that also count
as request roots (e.g. ICommand,IQuery,IMessage). Requests hidden
behind interfaces deriving from IRequest are always followed.

options.name: --handler-markers
options.description:
Comma-separated custom handler roots for external wrappers
(e.g. ICommandHandler,IQueryHandler). Source-declared wrappers
are followed automatically.

options.name: --watermark
options.description:
Custom watermark text rendered as block ASCII art in the console
and embedded as a watermark stamp in Markdown, HTML, and JSON reports.

options.name: --banner
options.description: Force rendering the ASCII art logo banner and summary card.

options.name: --no-banner
options.description: Suppress the ASCII art logo banner and summary card.

options.name: --color
options.description: Force ANSI 24-bit TrueColor gradients in console output.

options.name: --no-color
options.description: Disable ANSI colors in console output (also respects NO_COLOR).

options.name: --baseline
options.description:
Compare checks with a baseline file; --strict then fails only
on errors not present in the baseline.

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description: Record current checks as the baseline, then continue.

options.name: --diff
options.description:
Compare the current scan against a base ARCHITECTURE.json file or
base solution folder to see what changed in the CQRS surface.
--diff-output Write the architecture diff report (.md for PR comments, or .json).

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Also write SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning.

options.name: --summary
options.description: Also write a compact Markdown job summary.

options.name: --github-annotations
options.description: Emit file/line GitHub Actions annotations.

options.name: --ci-root
options.description: Repository root used to rebase annotation/SARIF paths.

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Exit with code 4 when architecture checks report an error
and the scan is complete; incomplete scans report diagnostics.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the tool version and exit.
